body:
Follow-up to #2696, closing the "known limitation" it left for later, as proposed in review: on a step some rank prefills, every rank — a decoding one included — picks the prefill token graph by the group's largest row count and pads to it.

## Problem

#2696 makes every prefilling DP rank replay one token-graph bucket. Without the prefill delayer (`ATOM_ENABLE_PREFILL_DELAYER=0`, or RapidServe) a step can still pair a prefill with a decode: an idle rank runs a dummy **decode** and a busy one keeps decoding. That rank ran its early layers eagerly beside a peer replaying the prefill recording, and the MoE's DP exchange differs on the two sides — a recorded custom all_gather at the bucket's height, on the peer buffers the group registered for that recording, against an eager variable-length gather — so the group hangs. On main (f554c19) with the delayer off this happens on the **first request**:

```
DP0: DECIDE pre=True  sched=526 run=1024 tg=True  prefill_dp=(True, False)   <- replays the 1024 bucket
DP1: DECIDE pre=False sched=6   run=6    tg=False prefill_dp=(True, False)   <- eager dummy decode
```

## Fix

- `ForwardMode._pad_to_token_graph`: whenever any rank prefills, settle one bucket for the **whole group** — the smallest prefill bucket holding the largest row count on any rank, prefilling or decoding — and pad every rank to it. `ForwardMode.prefill_token_graph` marks the step.
- `region_graph._phase`: on such a step a decoding rank keys its lookup under `"prefill"`, so it replays the recording its peers replay. Its attention is an eager region and still runs the decode it scheduled; the prefill recording's `rope_quant_window` hands it the window row (no decode fold), which the decode branch of `_attend` writes before attending.
- `ModelRunner._record_tr_graphs`: record each bucket with every rank at that bucket (the table every replay now has).
- The decoder after the KV source is unchanged: on a mixed step `req_graphs` stays off, the prefilling ranks run `DecoderGraph` eagerly, and a decoding rank runs every row, all under the stages `decoder_stages` sizes from the group's table (request buckets stay the group's `running_bs`). A decoding rank cannot replay a prefill `DecoderGraph`: it needs every verify row's logits, the replay computes each request's last row.
- Docs (`environment_variables.md`, `compilation_cudagraph_guide.md`, `distributed_guide.md`) describe the rule.

After this, with the delayer off a mixed step looks like:

```
DP0: DECIDE pre=False sched=6 run=1024 tg=True prefill_dp=(True, False)  -> replay _EarlyLayers phase=prefill rows=1024
```

## Validation (MI355X, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP2 `--enable-dp-attention`, PR #3965 CI server args)

Functional (1 request ~800 tok / 8 concurrent prompts of different lengths / new prompts during a 1500-token decode):

| ATOM | delayer | result |
|---|---|---|
| main f554c19 | off | hangs on the first request |
| this PR | off | all complete |
| this PR | on (default) | all complete |

GSM8K (full, 3-shot, `local-completions`, c64):

| ATOM | delayer | flexible / strict |
|---|---|---|
| this PR | off | 0.9287 / 0.9287, rerun 0.9174 / 0.9166 (459 steps had a rank decode on the prefill bucket) |
| this PR | on | 0.9158 / 0.9151 |
| main f554c19 | on | 0.9227 / 0.9227 |

AgentX trace replay, c32, 15 min:

| ATOM | delayer | requests | out tok/s/GPU | TTFT p50 / p90 | interactivity p50 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| this PR | off | 1484 / 1484 | 736 | 0.20 s / 0.65 s | 136 |
| this PR | on | 1505 / 1505 | 745 | 0.35 s / 1.09 s | 144 |
| main f554c19 | on (4 runs) | all complete | 732–748 | 0.33–0.36 s / 1.09–1.21 s | 143–145 |

Unit tests: `test_forward_mode.py test_region_graph.py test_dp_metadata.py test_dp_sync_layout.py test_scheduler.py test_prefill_delayer.py test_graph_holders.py test_dspark.py` — 371 passed; `black` / `ruff` clean.

## Not changed here

With the delayer on, a rank that has decodes still runs a dummy prefill on a peer's prefill step (`Scheduler.dummy_prefill`). After this change it could keep decoding on the prefill bucket instead. Tried it (drop the early return in `schedule()`; functional + GSM8K 0.9219 fine), but AgentX c32 (delayer on) regresses: 726 / 726 / 729 out tok/s/GPU, TTFT p50 0.40–0.42 s, interactivity 139–140, against main's 732–748, 0.33–0.36 s, 143–145 (4 runs) and this PR's 745, 0.35 s, 144. Likely (not profiled yet): on such a step the decoding rank runs layers 20–39 eagerly on every padded row, and the prefilling ranks can no longer replay `DecoderGraph`. Held back for a follow-up together with mixed batches.

### 🏷️ CI Guide

**Runs automatically on every eligible PR before approval:**
- ✅ Pre Checkin: Black, Ruff, catalog schema validation, non-GPU unit tests

**Heavy model tests:**
- ✅ Run after the PR is approved and Pre Checkin passes
- ✅ Run immediately when an approval review is submitted
- ✅ Can be requested before approval with labels

| Label | Tests |
|-------|-------|
| `ci:full` | Run all heavy PR model tests: native ATOM, vLLM, and SGLang |
| `ci:atom` | Run native ATOM model accuracy tests |
| `ci:vllm` | Run ATOM vLLM OOT model accuracy tests |
| `ci:sglang` | Run ATOM SGLang model accuracy tests |

> Heavy jobs are skipped when the PR is not approved and no matching `ci:*` label is present.
> Add labels via the sidebar or `gh pr edit 2697 --add-label <label>`

title: fix(dp): a decoding rank replays the group's prefill token-graph bucket
